purpose: Synthetic smoke tests for a short-panel temporal-precedence workflow

files.demo_evidence.csv: Classical, Bayesian-BIC, and blocked Random Forest evidence for planted linear, nonlinear, null, and common-driver predictors
files.common_driver_sensitivity.csv: False-lead comparison before and after time/common-shock adjustment
files.simulation_summary.csv: Detection rates from 100 replications per scenario and time length for classical two-way-within and Bayesian-BIC screens

warning: These are implementation smoke tests with deliberately visible signals, not universal power or size guarantees.
